sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.17539/2024, which is repeat (third) application under Section 389(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant - Kanhaiyalal Lodha S/o Ramesh Lodha.

The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 366,
372(2)(i), 376(2)(n) of the India Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 10 - 10 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine Rs.500 - 500/- under each sections.
The appellant has also been sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment along with fine of Rs.500/- under Section 3(2)(5) of the Schedules Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: With default clause to further undergo 1 - 1 year's additional rigorous imprisonment under each sections.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has suffered the jail incarceration of 07 years and 09 months.

The appellant has been convicted under Sections 366, 376(2)(i), 376(2)(n) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 10 years' rigorous imprisonment, however, under Section 3(2)(5)
of the SC & ST Act, he has been awarded Life Imprisonment.
There is no DNA and FSL report.
The prosecutrix was found minor on the basis of date of birth recorded in the scholar register.
The present appellant is aged about 25 years having no criminal 2 CRA-3562-2018 past.

Even otherwise,
this is an appeal of 2018 and could not come up for final hearing till date.
Hence, remaining jail sentence of the present appellant be suspended the he be released on bail.
Learned Deputy Advocate General for the respondent / State opposes the application.

Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that there is no likelihood of hearing disposal of this appeal, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail Kanhaiyalal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137024555/

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I.A. No.17539/2024 stands allowed.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Kanhaiyalal Lodha shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial and on depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 11.09.2025, thereafter, on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pending of the appeal.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
 (VIVEK RUSIA)
